key.name: spaces-per-monitor
key.description: How many virtual desktops each monitor starts with. Switching past the last space creates another, up to 12.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: Set to 0 to switch instantly with no animation.

key.name: active-monitor-mode
key.summary: How the target monitor is chosen
key.description: Either 'pointer' (monitor under the mouse) or 'focus' (monitor of the focused window, falling back to the pointer).

key.name: hide-overview-thumbnails
key.description: The stock workspace thumbnails are meaningless with per-monitor spaces, so hide them.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Show the current space of every monitor in the top panel.

key.name: show-osd
key.summary: Show an on-screen indicator when switching
key.description: Briefly show the new space number on the monitor that switched.

key.name: collapse-empty-spaces
key.description: When several empty spaces sit next to each other on a monitor, keep only one.

key.name: thumbnail-size
key.description: Width in pixels of space previews in the panel menu and switch popup.

key.name: switcher-timeout
key.summary: Time until the thumbnail menu disappears
key.description: Milliseconds the thumbnail menu stays after switching a screen. Hovering the menu keeps it open. Set to 0 to hide it immediately.

key.name: add-space
key.summary: Add a space to the current monitor

key.name: remove-space
key.summary: Remove the current space from the current monitor
